Main-text and supplementary figures for `Sasaki_Pespeni_LCWG.qmd`. This document only plots: the models and summaries come from `Output/Reports/report.qmd` (saved to `Output/Output_data/ms_objects.rds` in its last section) and from the processed data and cluster export read by `Scripts/load_data.R`. Render the report first whenever an analysis changes (`00_controller.R` steps 7 and 8).

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(here)
library(ggpubr)
library(lme4)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("Scripts", "themes.R"))
source(here("Scripts", "palettes.R"))
source(here("Scripts", "load_data.R"))
ms_file <- here("Output", "Output_data", "ms_objects.rds")
if (!file.exists(ms_file)) stop("Render Output/Reports/report.qmd first: it writes ", ms_file)
list2env(readRDS(ms_file), envir = globalenv())
cat("Objects from report.qmd, saved", format(file.mtime(ms_file), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: ms-fig-helpers
#| include: false
# rectangular phylogram as ggplot layers
tree_df <- function(tr) {
  tr <- ape::ladderize(tr)
  n <- ape::Ntip(tr)
  x <- ape::node.depth.edgelength(tr)
  y <- rep(NA_real_, n + tr$Nnode)
  tips <- tr$edge[tr$edge[, 2] <= n, 2]
  y[tips] <- rev(seq_along(tips))
  kids <- split(tr$edge[, 2], tr$edge[, 1])
  y_of <- function(nd) { if (!is.na(y[nd])) return(y[nd]); v <- mean(sapply(kids[[as.character(nd)]], y_of)); y[nd] <<- v; v }
  invisible(y_of(n + 1))
  edges <- tibble(p = tr$edge[, 1], c = tr$edge[, 2]) %>% mutate(x0 = x[p], x1 = x[c], y = y[c])
  verts <- map_dfr(names(kids), function(nd) { yy <- y[kids[[nd]]]; tibble(x = x[as.integer(nd)], y0 = min(yy), y1 = max(yy)) })
  nodes <- tibble(node = (n + 1):(n + tr$Nnode), x = x[node], y = y[node],
                  label = if (is.null(tr$node.label)) "" else as.character(tr$node.label))
  list(edges = edges, verts = verts, nodes = nodes,
       tips = tibble(label = tr$tip.label, x = x[1:n], y = y[1:n]), depth = max(x))
}
gg_tree <- function(tr, title, cols) {
  d <- tree_df(tr)
  ggplot() +
    geom_segment(data = d$edges, aes(x = x0, xend = x1, y = y, yend = y), linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_segment(data = d$verts, aes(x = x, xend = x, y = y0, yend = y1), linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_text(data = filter(d$nodes, label != "", label != "NA"), aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
              hjust = 1.15, vjust = -0.4, size = 2.8) +
    geom_text(data = d$tips, aes(x = x + d$depth * 0.03, y = y, label = label, colour = label,
                                 fontface = if_else(grepl("^A\\.", label), "italic", "bold")),
              hjust = 0, size = 3.6) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cols, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.45))) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: ms-fig3
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
# Figure 3: phenotype - CTmax differs more per degree between sites (space) than through the season,
# within clades (plasticity) and through clade composition (turnover)
ci_tab <- function(m, terms) {
  b <- lme4::fixef(m); se <- sqrt(diag(as.matrix(vcov(m))))
  tibble(term = terms, est = b[terms], lo = b[terms] - 1.96 * se[terms], hi = b[terms] + 1.96 * se[terms])
}

diff_dat <- wb_diff %>% filter(split == "Season-mean split") %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = rev(c("All clades", tonsa_clades))), all = group == "All clades")

m3_slopes <- ggplot(diff_dat, aes(x = diff, y = group, colour = group, shape = all)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), size = 1.5, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(clade_cols[tonsa_clades], `All clades` = "black"), guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 18), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Spatial − seasonal slope\n(°C CTmax per °C)", y = NULL) +
  theme_matt(base_size = 11)

m4_ctmax <- ggplot(filter(vp_tab, share > 0), aes(x = model, y = share, fill = component)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, colour = "white") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = vp_cols, name = NULL) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Share of CTmax variance") +
  theme_matt(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

m3_turn <- ggplot(turn_tab, aes(x = est, y = component, colour = axis, shape = axis)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 0.5, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Seasonal = "grey55", Spatial = "black"), name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(Seasonal = 17, Spatial = 16), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, 14)) +
  labs(x = "Slope\n(°C CTmax per °C)", y = NULL) +
  theme_matt(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggarrange(ggarrange(m3_slopes, m3_turn, nrow = 1, widths = c(1, 1), labels = c("A", "B")),
```

```{r}
#| label: ms-fig4
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 4.8
# Figure 4: genome - variation lies between sites, not seasons; seasonal change does not echo spatial temperature associations
# F spans divergent populations (Florida vs Chesapeake), so its between-site variance is ~10x the
# other clades': one panel per clade, each on its own scale
m4_freq_n <- ggplot(filter(vp_freq, !is.na(value)) %>% 
                      mutate(group = factor(group, levels = tonsa_clades)),
                    aes(x = component, y = value, shape = component, colour = group, group = group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) + 
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), size = 1.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17), name = NULL) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clade_cols) + 
  labs(x = "", y = expression("Variance / " * bar(p) * "(1 - " * bar(p) * ")")) +
  guides(shape = "none") +
  theme_matt_facets(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# concordance: seasonal z of each SNP, signed by its spatial direction (> 0 = same direction through
# the season as across sites); top 1% spatial SNPs vs all others. Fraction > 0 among the top 1% = the
# sign agreement of the concordance test; chance range from the within-site temperature permutations.
# |z| beyond 4.5, including the +-10 cap of the GLM (fits where an allele is missing from some
# populations), are kept and shown in the end bins.
conc_null <- conc %>% filter(snp_set == "all chr.", null == "seasonal", snps_used == "unlinked") %>%
  mutate(clade = as.character(clade)) %>% filter(clade %in% c("X", "F")) %>%
  group_by(clade) %>% summarise(obs = conc_top1[observed][1], lo = min(conc_top1[!observed]),
                                hi = max(conc_top1[!observed]), .groups = "drop")

conc_snps <- map_dfr(c("X", "F"), ~ read_tsv(cx("results", "14_concordance", paste0(.x, ".unlinked.snps.tsv.gz")),
                                            col_types = cols(chrom = "c", .default = col_double())) %>%
                       mutate(clade = .x)) %>%
  group_by(clade) %>%
  mutate(top = abs(z_spatial) >= quantile(abs(z_spatial), 0.99),
         oz = z_seasonal * sign(z_spatial)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(clade = factor(clade, levels = c("X", "F")))

# agreement as computed by the concordance test (cluster)
conc_lab <- conc_snps %>% filter(top) %>% group_by(clade) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(mutate(conc_null, clade = factor(clade, levels = c("X", "F"))), by = "clade") %>%
  mutate(lab = sprintf("Top 1%% (%d SNPs)\n%.0f%% same direction\nchance: %.0f to %.0f%%", n, 100 * obs, 100 * lo, 100 * hi))

conc_snps <- mutate(conc_snps, oz = pmin(pmax(oz, -4.6), 4.6))   # overflow into the end bins

m4_conc <- ggplot(conc_snps, aes(x = oz)) +
  geom_histogram(data = ~ filter(.x, !top), aes(y = after_stat(density)), binwidth = 0.25, boundary = 0,
                 fill = "grey80", colour = NA) +
  geom_histogram(data = ~ filter(.x, top), aes(y = after_stat(density), fill = clade), binwidth = 0.25, boundary = 0,
                 alpha = 0.75, colour = NA) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30") +
  geom_text(data = conc_lab, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = lab), hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.2, size = 2.8,
            lineheight = 0.95) +
  facet_wrap(~ clade, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-4.625, -2, 0, 2, 4.625), labels = c("≤ −4.5", "−2", "0", "2", "≥ 4.5")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.3))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clade_cols[c("X", "F")], guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Seasonal temperature z-score",
       y = "Density") +
  theme_matt_facets(base_size = 11)

ggarrange(m4_freq_n, m4_conc, 
          nrow = 1, widths = c(0.85, 1.15), 
          common.legend = T, legend = "bottom",
          labels = c("A", "B"))
```

```{r}
#| label: ms-fig5
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 5
# Figure 5: clade differences in CTmax and acclimation, from ctmax ~ clade * temperature (+ site, replicate, tube)
t_off <- mean(filtered_data$collection_temp - filtered_data$temp_cent)

ci_cols <- function(d) c(intersect(c("lower.CL", "asymp.LCL"), names(d))[1], intersect(c("upper.CL", "asymp.UCL"), names(d))[1])

clade_rng <- filtered_data %>% filter(clade %in% tonsa_clades) %>%
  group_by(clade) %>% summarise(lo = min(temp_cent), hi = max(temp_cent), .groups = "drop")

pred5 <- pmap_dfr(clade_rng, function(clade, lo, hi) {
  as_tibble(summary(emmeans::emmeans(ctmax.model, ~ clade | temp_cent,
                                     at = list(clade = clade, temp_cent = seq(lo, hi, length.out = 30)))))
}) %>% mutate(clade = factor(as.character(clade), levels = tonsa_clades), temp = temp_cent + t_off)

cc <- ci_cols(pred5)

pt5 <- filtered_data %>% filter(clade %in% tonsa_clades) %>% mutate(clade = factor(clade, levels = tonsa_clades))

m5a <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = pt5, aes(x = collection_temp, y = ctmax, colour = clade), alpha = 0.3, size = 1.3,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.25, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = pred5, aes(x = temp, ymin = .data[[cc[1]]], ymax = .data[[cc[2]]], fill = clade), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(data = pred5, aes(x = temp, y = emmean, colour = clade), linewidth = 1.3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = clade_cols[tonsa_clades], name = "Clade") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clade_cols[tonsa_clades], name = "Clade") +
  labs(x = "Collection temperature (°C)", y = "CTmax (°C)") +
  theme_matt(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

mm <- as_tibble(summary(emmeans::emmeans(ctmax.model, ~ clade), infer = TRUE))

tr <- as_tibble(summary(emmeans::emtrends(ctmax.model, ~ clade, var = "temp_cent"), infer = TRUE))

m5b <- bind_rows(
  transmute(mm, clade, est = emmean, lo = .data[[ci_cols(mm)[1]]], hi = .data[[ci_cols(mm)[2]]],
            panel = sprintf("CTmax at %.0f °C (°C)", t_off)),
  transmute(tr, clade, est = temp_cent.trend, lo = .data[[ci_cols(tr)[1]]], hi = .data[[ci_cols(tr)[2]]],
            panel = "Acclimation slope (°C per °C)")) %>%
  mutate(clade = factor(as.character(clade), levels = tonsa_clades), panel = factor(panel, levels = unique(panel))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = clade, y = est, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, colour = clade)) +
  geom_pointrange(size = 0.6, linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1, strip.position = "left") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = clade_cols[tonsa_clades], guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Clade", y = NULL) +
  theme_matt_facets(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside", strip.background = element_blank())

ggarrange(m5a, m5b, nrow = 1, widths = c(1.2, 1), labels = c("A", "B"))
```

```{r}
#| label: ms-fig6
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5.5
# Figure 6: warming tolerance with lineages + acclimation (distribution), and the warmest day under each scenario
if (have_mur) {
  
  hist6 <- wt_days %>%
    filter(scenario == "Clades + acclimation") %>%
    mutate(bin = floor(wt)) %>%
    group_by(region, warming, bin) %>% summarise(w = sum(w), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(region) %>% mutate(h = 0.9 * w / max(w)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(y0 = as.integer(region) - 1)
  
  m6_hist <- ggplot(hist6) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = y0), data = distinct(hist6, region, y0), colour = "grey80") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey30") +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = bin, xmax = bin + 1, ymin = y0, ymax = y0 + h, fill = region, alpha = warming)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = region_cols[region_order], guide = "none") +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`+4 °C` = 0.35, Current = 0.9), name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(region_order) - 1 + 0.35, labels = region_order, expand = expansion(add = c(0.1, 0.2))) +
    labs(x = "Daily warming tolerance, July–November (°C)", y = NULL) +
    theme_matt(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
  
  m6_hot <- wt_res %>%
    filter(scenario %in% scen_levels, metric != "Aug–Sep mean") %>%
    mutate(scenario = factor(scenario, levels = scen_levels),
           warming = factor(if_else(warming == 0, "Current", "+4 °C"), levels = c("Current", "+4 °C"))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = region, y = est, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, colour = scenario, shape = scenario)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey30") +
    geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~ warming, ncol = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Fixed CTmax` = "grey65", `Clade means` = "grey35", `Clades + acclimation` = "black"),
                        name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(`Fixed CTmax` = 15, `Clade means` = 17, `Clades + acclimation` = 16), name = NULL) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Warming tolerance on the warmest day (°C)") +
    theme_matt_facets(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))
  
  ggarrange(m6_hist, m6_hot, nrow = 1, widths = c(1, 1), labels = c("A", "B"))
}

```

## Supplemental 


```{r}
#| label: ms-figS-drift
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.5
# Supplementary: seasonal allele-frequency change against the drift expectation
m4_drift <- temporal %>%
  mutate(uncal = Fc - sampling_2n, clade = factor(as.character(clade), levels = tonsa_clades)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gens, colour = clade)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(aes(y = uncal), shape = 1, size = 2.3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(y = excess, ymin = excess - 1.96 * se, ymax = excess + 1.96 * se), size = 0.45) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = clade_cols[tonsa_clades], name = "Clade", drop = TRUE) +
  labs(x = "Generations between samples", y = expression(F[c] - "sampling noise"),
       caption = "Open: assuming 2 chromosomes per individual; filled: calibrated, 95% CI.") +
  theme_matt(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
m4_drift
```
